Ruling: batch #326 item 1 · letter D · maintainer 「同意，立卡」 2026-10-12T08:44Z

Director seat, summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB` (GitHub `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). The maintainer asked for this card's analysis on the direct channel (「22991 帮我综合分析，和我讨论」); this seat measured the job (part 1 of the card, below), presented the four options of part 2 with the critical path each reaches, and recommended D. The maintainer stated the governing principle verbatim, 「我觉得能让整个车队提速的方案就是好方案，main 很多天才会发一个版本，我只要确保发版本之前做好各种测试就可以。」, and answered 「同意，立卡」. The principle is filed as the governance card #22998 (two-speed CI); this card is its first execution.

## The ruling

**D: option (a), lanes behind an aggregator, plus the PM dispatch-gates self-test's slow tier leaves the `pull_request` / `merge_group` path.**
- `Lint & Repo Gates` becomes an aggregator job that only `needs:` the lanes, name kept (the required context is matched by name, AGENTS.md:519); the lanes get new names. The roster discipline of `TypeScript Type Check` applies: `OS_AGGREGATOR_MEMBERS` in YAML, `scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs` statically, `toJSON(needs)` at run time.
- Lane cut, from the sum of step medians: ESLint with the engine test-double gate (about 2.3 min); the 137 tree-wide gates in three lanes of about 3 min each; the scoped ratchets and corpus checks (query-options erasure 143 s, slot-lookup 75 s, comment-mask 61 s, verify-lock 99 s) in one lane; the PM dispatch-gates self-test in its own lane. Each lane pays about 1 min of checkout and install. Lane budget: 5 minutes at median; a lane over budget splits, it does not skip.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` on `pull_request` / `merge_group` runs the FAST tier (`--self-test --fast`); the SLOW tier runs on `schedule` and `push: main`, the full battery. #22076's constraint stands: every case still runs at least daily. The slow tier's red is a main-red under the governance card's rule.
- Not taken: (b), extending per-family path scoping to the 137 tree-wide gates (their input is the tree; a wrong declaration skips a gate silently); (c), input caches (the same declaration problem). The 50 always-on gate self-tests cost 1.8 min together and are not worth scoping.
- Expected critical path: a product-only run about 4–7 min (from 12.9 median today); a PM-touching run about 5–8 min (from 29.2); the queue entry then waits on the `CI` workflow (13.6 min median), which the governance card addresses.

## What this seat measured (part 1 of the card; 31 completed `Lint & Repo Gates` runs, 18 `pull_request` and 13 `merge_group`, read from the jobs API on 2026-10-12)

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| job wall min / median / p90 / max | 6 / 15.5 / 32.1 / 36.4 min |
| steps | 198, serial, one runner; 187 always-on (11.5 min of medians) and 11 path-scoped (17.1 min when all run) |
| step dependencies | none except `steps.gate-families.outputs.*` (9 reads); one step id in the job |
| PM dispatch-gates self-test | ran in 10 of 31 runs; median 534 s, p90 861 s, max 903 s; the job's wall with it 29.2 min median (max 36.4), without it 12.9 (max 20.9) |
| other scoped steps | query-options erasure 143 s (ran 20 of 31) · verify-lock 99 s (9) · slot-lookup 75 s (20) · comment-mask corpus 61 s (24) · workflow-command gate 48 s (11) |
| always-on heavies | ESLint 96 s · engine test-double 39 s · checkout 31 s · tenant-audit census 28 s · ADR anchors 25 s |
| tail | 145 steps under 5 s = 2.3 min; 44 steps of 5–30 s = 7.6 min; 9 steps of 30 s or more |
| merge-group walls (success) | 12.1–36.4 min, median 13.8; the `CI` workflow of the same groups 13.6 median |

The per-run and per-step data sit in this seat's scratchpad (`audit/lint-steps.json`); the reading script uses only the jobs API and the dev can re-run it.

Prior rulings read: #19189 (closed `not_planned`; its reopen condition is met by the table above, and this card carries it), #19686 (the aggregator pattern and roster discipline), #22076 (the two tiers; CI runs both today per the header of `scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`), #16496 (five scoped families), #21050 (timeouts), AGENTS.md:519 (required contexts by name).

## After this ruling
- Labels: `tooling` · `domain:devx` · `area:devpath` · `priority:p1` (the grade #19189 carried when this job stalled the queue; triage may re-grade) · `pm:queue`. Body line 1 names the protected surface (the tooling queue-entry rule).
- Follow-ups named, not carried: `Type Check · workspace` (11.8 min median on merge groups, the next bottleneck) and the `Test Core` shard variance (3.7 min median, 15.2 p90), on the governance card's lane.
- ⛔ No code by this seat; no dev dispatched by this seat.
